component.name: Gary
component.summary: Develop and test game integrations for the Neuro-sama SDK

description.p: A feature-rich app that helps you develop and test game integrations for the Neuro-sama SDK. A wide range of tools and environments to test your game integration, in one app.

ul.li: A random generator to automatically choose actions, for primitive or "hands-off" testing
Manual action sending, with an option to send raw WebSocket messages for low-level testing
For advanced testing, use a real LLM through OpenAI-compatible inference providers
Diagnostics - easy automatic checks for common pitfalls and off-spec behavior
